cohort.document_identity: Each .id is SHA-256 of casefolded, whitespace-collapsed UTF-8 text. The full projection binds each document's exact UTF-8 SHA-256, publisher/parent IDs, word count, generator, group, role and domain.
cohort.language: English; production Deep admission on all four documents
cohort.selection_method: Seed 42. Only singleton source components from the original five datasets, PERSUADE control corpus and both new shards. One human rewrite, one machine rewrite and both exact clean parents per source. Stress draws first from stack-training sources absent from prior fits.
